positions.title: Lecturer
positions.organisation: School of Rural Health, Monash University

paragraphs: Eleanor is currently involved in several health education and rural health workforce research projects, as well as, many community-based, primary health care and clinical research projects.

supervision.statement: Eleanor is interested in supervising honours, masters and PhD students on topics relating to the above fields and how they compare, relate and impact on rural communities.

interests.text: Rural and Indigenous Health, including Rural Health Services and Workforce issues
Primary Health Care and Population Health particularly 'Healthy start to life' and 'Ageing well' 'Ageing productively'.

keywords: Health workforce development especially in rural areas
